description.fun: A pint-sized brawler that will challenge anyone, however big, and never quits no matter how often it loses. Tyrogue is the only Pokémon whose evolution is decided by its stats, so the way it trains decides whether it grows into Hitmonlee, Hitmonchan or Hitmontop. It also tied Hitmonlee and Hitmonchan, two Pokémon that had been unrelated, into one family.
description.guide: A small, purple Fighting baby Pokémon introduced in Generation 2, always eager to fight and train. It evolves at level 20 into Hitmonlee, Hitmonchan or Hitmontop, depending on how its Attack compares with its Defense. It is male-only.
description.tagline: A pint-sized brawler that picks fights with anyone

branches.text: Tyrogue's training decides its future. If its Attack is higher than its Defense when it evolves, it becomes the kicker Hitmonlee; if its Defense is higher, the boxer Hitmonchan; and if the two are equal, the spinning Hitmontop, which was added alongside Tyrogue in Generation 2.

description.fun: Hitmonlee's legs stretch and snap back like springs, giving its kicks huge reach, and its excellent balance lets it kick in succession from any position. It hardens the soles of its feet just before impact, and after a fight it rubs down its legs to loosen the muscles. Its English name nods to a legendary martial-arts film star, and its Japanese name to a famous kickboxer.
description.guide: A Fighting Pokémon that specialises in kicks, with springy legs that can stretch to strike from a distance. It has no distinct head and is male-only. It evolves from Tyrogue when Tyrogue's Attack is higher than its Defense.
description.tagline: The kick master, with legs like springs

description.fun: Hitmonchan punches faster than the eye can see, finishing its combos with a straight punch said to top 480 km/h, and its corkscrew punches can drill through concrete. Its 'boxing gloves' are actually masses of muscle. Like a real boxer, it needs a break every three minutes, the length of a boxing round, but it never gives up in a tough fight.
description.guide: A Fighting Pokémon that specialises in punches, with what look like boxing gloves but are actually masses of muscle. It punches faster than the eye can see but needs a break every three minutes. It is male-only and evolves from Tyrogue when Tyrogue's Defense is higher than its Attack.
description.tagline: A boxer whose gloves are pure muscle

description.fun: Hitmontop gets around faster by spinning on the spike on its head than by walking, and it fights with graceful, dance-like kicks, its spin multiplying their power tenfold. It's based on spinning tops and capoeira, the Angolan-Brazilian martial art, and fittingly a Tyrogue only becomes one when its Attack and Defense are perfectly balanced, like a top. The horn on its head keeps growing all its life.
description.guide: A Fighting Pokémon introduced in Generation 2 that fights by spinning on its head and delivering kicks. It is male-only and evolves from Tyrogue when Tyrogue's Attack and Defense are equal. It is based on spinning tops and capoeira.
description.tagline: A breakdancing brawler that spins on its head

transitions.how: Level 20, with Attack higher than Defense

note.text: Tyrogue is a baby Pokémon, added in Generation 2, a generation after the Hitmonlee it can grow into.

transitions.how: Level 20, with Defense higher than Attack

note.text: Tyrogue is a baby Pokémon, added in Generation 2, a generation after the Hitmonchan it can grow into.

transitions.how: Level 20, with Attack equal to Defense

note.text: Tyrogue is a baby Pokémon. It and Hitmontop arrived together in Generation 2, joining Hitmonlee and Hitmonchan from Generation 1.
